description: Returns a set of short term credentials you can use to perform privileged tasks on a member account in your organization. You must use credentials from an Organizations management account or a delegated administrator account for IAM to call AssumeRoot.
mitreAttackSubTechniques: T1548.005 - Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Temporary Elevated Cloud Access

incidents.description: What the June 2026 Threat Technique Catalog update means for your AWS environment

securityImplications: Attackers might use AssumeRoot from a compromised Organizations management or delegated-administrator account to obtain root access to a member account, bypassing the access controls that the member account's administrator configured.
